title: RealTimePlugin
description: RealTimePlugin is a lightweight plugin that displays time on the action bar. Supports real and Minecraft time, seconds display, and saves each player's settings.
body:
A simple and lightweight plugin for that displays the current time on the action bar (above the hotbar) for players. The plugin supports two time modes: real (system) time with customizable timezone and Minecraft time. Each player can individually customize the display, and all settings are automatically saved and restored when reconnecting to the server.

✨ **What's New in v2.0**

🌍 Timezone Support - Choose your own timezone! Perfect for players from different regions

🇺🇦 Ukrainian Timezones - Europe/Kyiv, Europe/Uzhgorod, Europe/Zaporozhye included

🕐 Automatic DST Handling - Summer/winter time changes are handled automatically

📋 Timezone List - See all available timezones with /realtime timezone list

⭐ **Main Features**

⏰ Time display on the action bar (above the hotbar)

🌍 Two modes: real time (with timezone support) or Minecraft time

⏱️ Seconds toggle: enable/disable seconds display

🗺️ Multiple timezones: Europe, America, Asia, UTC, and more

💾 Settings saving: each player has their own settings that persist after reconnection

🔧 Flexible configuration: all messages, colors, and prefix can be changed in config.yml

🔄 Hot reload: /realtime reload command to apply config changes without server restart

🎮 **Commands**

/realtime help	Show command list

/realtime	Show your current settings

/realtime toggle	Enable/disable time display

/realtime mode <real/minecraft>	Switch between real and Minecraft time

/realtime seconds	Toggle seconds display

/realtime timezone <name>	Set your timezone

/realtime timezone list	Show all available timezones

/realtime reload	Reload configuration (OP only)

🌐 **Available Timezones**

**Ukraine**: Europe/Kyiv, Europe/Uzhgorod, Europe/Zaporozhye

**Europe**: Europe/London, Europe/Berlin, Europe/Paris, Europe/Rome, Europe/Madrid

**America**: America/New_York, America/Chicago, America/Denver, America/Los_Angeles

**Asia**: Asia/Tokyo, Asia/Shanghai, Asia/Dubai, Asia/Singapore

**Other**: UTC, Australia/Sydney, System (server time)
